laws.rule: Chiapas charges a state lodging tax (impuesto sobre hospedaje) on stays in hotels, motels, inns, villas, cabins and campsites, caravan parking, timeshares, and houses or apartments booked through apps and digital platforms. The rate is 2% of the amount paid, or 5% in motels. The provider collects it when the guest pays, and a platform that takes the payment pays it to the state. Meals, transport and VAT are outside the base (Código de la Hacienda Pública para el Estado de Chiapas, art. 239 to 241 A).

sources.title: Código de la Hacienda Pública para el Estado de Chiapas (last reform published 22 January 2025)
sources.authority: Gobierno del Estado de Chiapas, Consejería Jurídica

local-law.notes: Only the state lodging tax is checked. Palenque and Lagunas de Montebello park fees, municipal rules and state alcohol hours aren't checked.
